messages:
ashley: Heads up — large 5xx spike for gpt-serving in us-west-2, racks r09-r12. LB reports thousands of TX drops and a lot of connection resets. Jobs hitting NCCL / RDMA timeouts. Anyone on network?

matt: oncall here. any quick logs?

ashley: paste from lb agent: `lbctl stats --svc gpt-serving --since 10m` -> `drop_count: 24_312, last_reset: 1768804280`.

ashley: kube output from a failing pod: `RuntimeError: NCCL error 15 (unreachable peer)` and dmesg shows `rdma: QP timeout on port 1`

kevin: GPU-ops seeing same — a few GPUs report PCIe link retrains around same time. Could be network/rdma flapping upstream.

chandra: I’m seeing TC filters on the spines doing GRE encaps for east-west LB handoff. GRE adds ~42 bytes, current ToR MTU is 9216, but some racks are using 9000 for a long tail. Fragmentation + DF causing blackholes.

sophia: that matches: packets >9000 with DF set could drop silently and RDMA won’t recover. Any recent BPF/conntrack changes?

matt: @chandra can you show the active tc filters and routes?

chandra: `tc filter show dev bond0 ingress` -> shows a custom bpf clsact program that rewrites skb->mark for lb steering. Also `ip link show dev eth0 mtu` differs per host (9000 vs 9216).

ashley: ah — we pushed the new BPF LB policy during the 08:00 deploy. rolling back would stop the rewrite but we need a safer mitigation.

kevin: short term: disable GRE encaps on the spines for the gpt-serving service, and set LB to use direct routing (no encaps). That should avoid the +42B overhead.

matt: on it. switching traffic policy to no-encap for svc gpt-serving now. `infractl lb update --svc gpt-serving --encap none --reason urgent`

deploy-bot: change queued: infractl job 9876 started by matt.

chandra: also recommend aligning MTU on affected ToRs to 9216 and set `net.ipv4.ip_no_pmtu_disc=0` temporarily so hosts do PMTU discovery instead of dropping. Planning a ToR config push at 1768804600 if it looks stable.

sophia: can we migrate critical GPU jobs off r09-r12 to reserve pool while we validate? I can trigger pod disruption budgets to prefer r01-r04.

kevin: migrating low-priority jobs now. high-priority inference lanes kept but scaled down.

matt: lb update finished, rolling traffic. watching metrics.

ashley: quick metric check: errors dropped from 18% -> 2% within 60s. NCCL timeouts reduced.

chandra: plan to revert BPF change and rework marking logic to account for encapsulation overhead. Will open a follow-up PR and schedule a canary on single rack.

matt: create an incident with timeline + mitigation steps?

ashley: created incident INC-2026-0345, notes attached. tagging oncall for follow-up and postmortem. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: incident INC-2026-0345 created by ashley (link: https://incidents.redwood.local/INC-2026-0345)

kevin: long term action: add MTU sanity check to node onboarding + LB BPF should fail-safe if path MTU < pkt_size + encaps_overhead. Filing infra ticket.

ashley: thanks all — keeping this thread open until ToR push completes.
